notes:
Summary: Ferrum Edge Labs builds an RTB decisioning layer for programmatic advertising where inference latency directly impacts win-rate and CPM. Primary ask: reduce per-request cost while holding strict tail latency (p95) SLAs. Current constraints: ~1000 sustained QPS at peak, typical request payloads low-context (title+1-3 features) but spikes with 50-100 token contexts for personalization. Target SLOs: p95 < 20ms (preferably < 15ms) for model decision path; budget sensitivity: aggressive — wants to shave >30% inference spend.

Optimization interest: batching policy suggestions for mixed short/long sequences; prefix/KV caching for repeat contexts; 4-bit and 3-bit quantization profiles with accuracy fallbacks; dynamic routing to cheaper model variants under load. Wants Redwood Optimize to produce actionable configs (batch size, latency guardrails, quantization profile) and an apples-to-apples benchmarking harness.

What we tried: internal micro-batching on CPU + offload to GPU for warm state; saw 2-3x latency variance under burst. Ferrum ran a preliminary quantized Llama2-13B q4 file but saw 6-8% quality degradation on reranking metric. They asked about Redwood's kernel selection and kernel-level perf tradeoffs.

Quotes / paraphrases: "If we lose CTR by optimizing cost, the math doesn't work. Need clear quality guardrails." 
"Can you show exact perf runs — not synthetic — using our 30m sample trace?"

POC goal: end-to-end benchmarking harness that runs their 30M-sample trace (subsampled) through three configs: hosted small model (cost baseline), dedicated optimized (continuous batching + caching), private quantized variant (4-bit). Deliverables: p95/p99 latency histograms, cost per 1M tokens, metric delta on rerank NDCG, suggested rollout policy for staged canary.

Risks/concerns: procurement wants SOC2 + data residency in us-east; infra team worried about cold-starts and KV cache invalidation; legal flagged ad-data retention rules.

Sales posture/asks: Ferrum is price-sensitive; open to annual committed dedicated pool if Redwood can prove >=35% cost reduction with <=2% NDCG drop. AE note: push Redwood Optimize + 3-month dedicated POC.
